subject.title: fix(discord): preserve content-type and skip optimization for animated/WebP images

question: Should preserved WebP/AVIF/animated media be a public plugin SDK option with fail-closed over-cap behavior, or should this fix stay internal to Discord with compatibility-preserving fallback semantics?
rationale: The implementation choice affects a public plugin SDK subpath and whether existing oversized static or animated media sends keep delivering via optimization or start failing at runtime.

options.title: Keep the fix Discord-internal
options.body: Remove or avoid the public SDK preserve flags, thread MIME types through current Discord upload paths, and preserve existing over-cap static-image delivery where animation is not at risk.

options.title: Approve the public SDK contract
options.body: Keep the new SDK options only with maintainer-visible docs, API/export checks, tests, and explicit acceptance that oversized preserved media can fail closed.

options.title: Pause for a replacement branch
options.body: Close or pause this stale conflicting branch after opening a narrower replacement that preserves contributor credit and resolves the current-main drift.

recommendation.title: Keep the fix Discord-internal
recommendation.body: Remove or avoid the public SDK preserve flags, thread MIME types through current Discord upload paths, and preserve existing over-cap static-image delivery where animation is not at risk.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history ties steipete to both Discord extension surfaces and plugin SDK contract/documentation work, which are the main unresolved product/API boundaries.
